about: A code law accepts all six proof tools or a test command. Proof tools and targets are part of the canonical form. Unknown tools and watched code laws are refused.
laws:
laws "conformance" version 1

law kani
  says "The invariant holds."
  why "Conformance."
  on code "src/**"
  evidence proved by kani "checks::invariant" in "ril-core"

law verus
  says "The invariant holds."
  why "Conformance."
  on code "src/**"
  evidence proved by verus "verified.rs"

law lean
  says "The invariant holds."
  why "Conformance."
  on code "src/**"
  evidence proved by lean "Proof.lean"

law cedar-analysis
  says "The invariant holds."
  why "Conformance."
  on code "src/**"
  evidence proved by cedar-analysis "policy.cedar"

law quint
  says "The invariant holds."
  why "Conformance."
  on code "src/**"
  evidence proved by quint "model.qnt"

law bend
  says "The invariant holds."
  why "Conformance."
  on code "src/**"
  evidence proved by bend "LAWS.bend"

law command
  says "The invariant holds."
  why "Conformance."
  on code "src/**"
  evidence tested by command "make laws"
